stem: A particle is moving along a circular path of radius R. For the first quarter of the circle it travels with a speed ‘v’ and then it covers another third of the circle with a speed of ‘2v’ and finally the remaining part with speed ‘3v’. Find its average speed.

assets.alt: A circle of radius R starting at the top. The first quarter (blue) is covered at v, the next third (green) at 2v, and the remaining five-twelfths (red) at 3v, back to the start.
